avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces lusutrombopag exposure and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before lusutrombopag initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate thrombotic risk and platelet aggregation effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consider alternative adaptogens if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects may additive with lusutrombopag's mechanism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased bleeding; use with clinical judgment

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high-dose)
caution_supplements.action: Monitor platelet counts; standard dietary doses generally safe

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases lusutrombopag plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products throughout treatment duration

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase lusutrombopag absorption; food effect documented but manageable
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent pattern

monitoring_notes: Monitor platelet counts closely during therapy, particularly when adding/removing CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers. Assess for signs of thrombosis given the mechanism of action and patient population (cirrhosis with portal hypertension).
